title: Folding panel sections: one open at a time

spec.phase: Phase UI — Studio design and UX (release 3.0.0)
spec.summary: Panels in the media studio show every section open, one under another (the Audio panel: Sound, Record voice, Sound tracks, each track …), so the user scrolls to find a control and long panels feel endless. 503 puts the sections of every studio panel and inspector into **folding sections** (accordions) where **only one is open at a time**: opening one closes the others; the open one is remembered per panel; the title row shows a short summary when closed (e.g. "Music · 2 tracks"). The print studio uses the same part (501).

US-1.text: As a creator, I want to see the list of what a panel offers at a glance and open the one I need, instead of scrolling past everything.

US-2.text: As a returning user, I want the section I used last to be open when I come back to a panel.

US-3.text: As a keyboard user, I want to move between sections and open them with the keyboard.

AC-1.text: The folding section part opens one section per group at a time: opening a section closes the others in its group; a closed section shows its title and an optional one-line summary; a group can allow none open. Unit-tested on the open-state logic.

AC-2.text: The open section is remembered per panel and mode (local, per viewer) and restored when the panel opens again; a section whose content becomes needed (e.g. selecting a sound clip opens the Sound section of the inspector) opens itself.

AC-3.text: Every media-studio panel and inspector with more than one section uses the folding section part: Media, Text, Elements, Draw, Transitions, Audio, Layers, the photo editor's Light / Colour / Detail / Masks …, the clip, layer and sound inspectors; and the print studio's steps. A unit test lists panels with more than one section that don't.

AC-4.text: Each section title is a button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; Enter and Space toggle it; the panel's sections are reachable with Tab in order.

AC-5.text: At 1280 × 720 no media-studio panel needs to scroll with its default section open, except lists (media, layers, sounds) which scroll inside their section (deferred to 590).

Q1.text: Print studio too? _Answer (accepted 2026-10-20):_ yes, one open at a time in the print studio's steps as well, keeping Collapse all; Expand all is removed. Alternative: keep Expand all in the print studio only.

Q2.text: Can the user pin a second section open? _Answer (accepted 2026-10-20):_ no, for simplicity; revisit after 590's manual check.

sections.title: Non-Functional Requirements
sections.markdown:
- **Performance:** no new work on the preview or export path; the entry chunk stays ≤ 350 KB; panels open in under 100 ms.
- **Accessibility:** every control works from the keyboard with a visible focus ring and is announced; axe passes; text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in the light and dark themes.
- **Compatibility:** web and desktop alike; phones (≤ 640 px) and laptops (1280 × 720) as well as wide screens; every saved project opens unchanged.
- **Free and open source:** no new dependency unless cleared in `specs/licensing.md` first.

sections.title: Out of Scope
sections.markdown: - Changing what controls a section contains (other features).

sections.title: Approach
sections.markdown:
503 changes how sections fold, never what they contain (Out of Scope). Today the print studio's steps use 501's `FoldSection` (`components/panel/FoldSection.tsx`), where each section folds on its own and remembers itself under `chitthi-sections`; the media studio's panels and inspectors are plain `

…

` blocks, all open. **§1 One open per group: pure logic (AC-1).** A new `components/panel/foldGroups.ts`, framework-free like `railWidth.ts`: a group's state is the id of its open section or `null`. `toggleFold(open, id, allowNone)` opens `id` (closing the rest) or, when `id` is already open, closes it if the group allows none. `resolveFold(saved, present, fallback)` gives the section to show: the saved one if it is on screen, else the group's default (its first section unless the panel names one), or `null` when `null` was saved in a group that allows none. Tested without React. **§2 Remembered per panel and mode (AC-2).** A small store in the same folder (`useSyncExternalStore`, like the rail width) keeps `{ [group]: sectionId | null }` in `localStorage` under a new key `chitthi-folds`, per viewer; storage blocked = it still works, just not remembered. The old per-section key `chitthi-sections` means nothing under one-open and is removed on the first write. Nothing goes into designs or projects, so every saved project opens unchanged. **§3 `FoldGroup` and `FoldSection`.** `FoldGroup` (new, replacing `FoldScope`) gives its sections a group id, `allowNone` and an optional default. `FoldSection` keeps its props (`id`, `title`, `note`) and gains: `actions` (controls drawn beside the title button, not in it: the keyframe arrows in `kf-head` titles today, since a button cannot hold a button) and `openWhen` (a boolean: when it turns true the section opens itself, AC-2). Its title stays `

sections.title: Data Structures & Interfaces
Techniques
sections.markdown:
- **Pure logic, thin component:** the open-state rules live in `foldGroups.ts` (tested in node); the component only reads the store and renders, as `railWidth.ts` does for the rail.
- **Rendering checked without a DOM:** the unit tests run in node (no jsdom); AC-4's markup is checked with `react-dom/server`'s `renderToStaticMarkup` from a `.ts` test using `createElement`, already a dependency. No new library.
- **Coverage as a source scan:** like 501's `sharedParts.test.ts`, the coverage test reads `src/components/{studio,ig,panes}` and fails on a panel heading (`<h3`) that is not a `FoldSection`, with a short exception list (export dialogs) each with a reason.
- **Rising edge for `openWhen`:** the section opens when the value goes from false to true, not while it stays true, so the user can still close it.

| AC-2 | `foldGroups.test.ts`: saved per group, restored, a saved section no longer on screen falls back, blocked storage still toggles, the old key removed; `openWhen` rising edge | unit |
| AC-3 | `tests/unit/components/panel/foldCoverage.test.ts`: no panel component in `studio/`, `ig/`, `panes/` keeps an `<h3>` section of its own (exceptions listed with reasons and still needed); `Pane` has no Expand all; proven to fail by putting an `ig-group` `<h3>` back | unit |
| AC-4 | `tests/unit/components/panel/foldMarkup.test.ts`: `renderToStaticMarkup` of a group of three: each title is a `<button type="button">` with `aria-expanded` and an `aria-controls` naming its body, one body not `hidden`, titles in order, `actions` outside the button | unit |
| AC-5 | At 1280 × 720 each media panel with its default section open has no panel scroll (lists scroll inside) | e2e (590) |

sections.title: Decisions for the maintainer
sections.markdown:
_Chosen (the maintainer, 2026-10-20): A for all four (D-068)._

**D1 A panel's untitled top.** Some panels start with an untitled group: Add sound (Audio), the media list and add button (Media), Add text / the layer list (Layers). **A (recommended)** it stays above the sections, always visible: it is the panel's main action or list. **B** it becomes a section of its own ("Add sound") and folds like the rest.

**D2 Can a group have none open?** **A (recommended)** yes, everywhere: clicking the open title closes it (the print studio's Collapse all needs this anyway), and "none" is remembered. **B** only in the print studio; in the media studio one section is always open.

**D3 Masks.** `MaskPanel` shows type settings only for the selected mask (Brush, Linear / Radial gradient, Colour / Brightness range, Found by AI). **A (recommended)** sections: Selected mask (with its type's settings inside, under a smaller title) and Found by AI; the selected mask's section opens itself when a mask is chosen. **B** every type group is its own section.

**D4 The inspector's first section.** The clip inspector's first group ("Clip 2 · video": name, missing-file note, timing, fade) holds warnings. **A (recommended)** the name and any warning stay above the sections, always visible; the timing and fade become a "Timing" section. **B** the whole group folds like the rest.

files.purpose: `FoldGroup` (replaces `FoldScope`), `actions`, `openWhen`, one open per group, `revealSection` through the store (§3)
Panel and inspector slots wrapped in their `FoldGroup` (§4)
Titled `ig-group`s → `FoldSection`; `openWhen` for Record voice, the selected mask, a clicked cut (§5)
`.sec` in the media studio's panels and inspector; `actions` beside the title
The folding rule and the panel map; what users see

risks.text: **Photo editing gets slower when Light and Colour are both used** (one open at a time, Q2). Mitigation: the last section is remembered; the titles are one click; revisited after 590's manual check, as Q2 says.

**A control reached from elsewhere is hidden in a closed section** (Shift + R, the recovery bar, the feature finder, a clicked cut, agent tools that expect a field). Mitigation: `openWhen` and `revealSection` open it; the agent tools change data through `src/agent/tools.ts`, not the panels, so they are unaffected.

**Fields in a closed section are unmounted or hidden, losing local state** (a half-typed number, the open recorder). Mitigation: bodies are `hidden`, not unmounted, as `FoldSection` does today; the recorder closes the microphone when its section closes, as it does when the panel closes (209 AC-7).
**The print studio loses sections users kept open.** Mitigation: Q1 accepted; the first open step section is the remembered one or the first; Collapse all stays.

constitution.notes: Spec Approved 2026-10-20; this plan waits for D1–D4.
AC-1–AC-4 unit tests, test-first; AC-5 deferred to 590.
No new dependency; `react-dom/server` is part of `react-dom`.

constitution.principle: VIII. What You See Is What You Get
constitution.notes: No preview or export code changes; no design data changes.
Native buttons with `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`; panel code is lazy, entry chunk unchanged (checked at close).

constitution.principle: XI. Agents Use the Same Code
constitution.notes: A viewing preference, not a feature: agent tools act on data, unaffected; no new tool.

tasks.intro:
**Plan:** `./plan.md`
Legend: `[P]` = can run in parallel with the previous task; 👤 = needs a person. Each task lists files and the proving test.
Test-first: each "failing" task must fail before its paired implementation makes it pass. Tasks run one at a time in the main session.
Tasks are proven by unit tests only (D-033); AC-5 (panels fit at 1280 × 720) is in `590` ("Deferred checks collected from the phase").
